about_the_game:
Step into the dohyo and chase the dream of becoming Yokozuna.

Dohyo Dreams: Rise to Yokozuna is a narrative driven sumo RPG that blends intense matches with the quiet rituals of stable life. You will train, cook, sweep floors, and build bonds with your fellow rikishi, all while uncovering hidden stories that run beneath the surface. Every day is a step toward greatness or a stumble that teaches you what it means to stand back up.

This is a sumo RPG built on storytelling, ritual, and grit. One moment you are locked in a first person struggle on the clay, the next you are chopping vegetables with your stablemates, or exploring your world from a top down view like a classic RPG.

Beneath the surface of stable life are stories of pain and redemption. A Yokozuna with a past that refuses to stay buried. A young hopeful chasing a dream that may break him before it lifts him. Bonds formed over shared meals, laughter, and bruises. Every triumph carries the shadow of loss, but every setback opens the door to growth. Dohyo Dreams is about the scars we carry, the family we build, and the fight to rise no matter how heavy the clay feels beneath our feet.

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes depictions of intense competitive combat (sumo wrestling), and narrative themes of physical and emotional struggle. The story also touches on sensitive topics such as depression, trauma, and recovery. There is no sexual content, sexual assault, explicit gore, or extreme violence. Some players may find the portrayal of personal hardships and mental health themes emotionally challenging.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 280 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

short_description: Dohyo Dreams: Rise to Yokozuna is a narrative sumo RPG that blends first person combat, life simulation, and story rich exploration. Train, cook, bond with stablemates, and fight to rise to the pinnacle of sumo.
